ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; visible surface consists of >95% low-intensity pixels with high-intensity pixels limited to specular reflections and water-surface interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe shows high-amplitude, low-frequency scalloped indentations; right lobe shows high-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a convex distal trajectory; right lobe follows a linear-to-concave sweep toward the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced semi-circular notch on the lateral-distal edge of the left lobe; small dark appendage/filament visible at the extreme tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant morphological asymmetry between the trailing edge topographies of the left and right lobes.
